senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. רתע)to bubble, boil, be hot.—Part. רוֹתֵחַ; f. רוֹתַחַת; pl. רוֹתְחִים, רוֹתְחִין; רוֹתְחוֹת. [Tradit. pronunc. רוּתָח adj.] Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵃ חלב ר׳ milk fresh from the goat.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:1:3">Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>והרי הוא ר׳ ומרתיח</he> but is not the iron spit hot and does is not impart heat (to the lamb on it)? Bab.

Ib. 94ᵇ כל העולם כולו ר׳ וכ׳ (in the summer) the whole world is hot, and the springs are cold; כל … מעיינות ר׳ (in the winter) the whole world is cold, and the springs are hot; a. fr.—Esp. רוֹתְחִין hot water.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:3">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 12a:4">R. Hash. 12ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01415"><he>קִלְקֵל</he></cite>. Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ bot., v. <cite ref="K00204"><he>כָּוָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:15">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>כשתראה אותי נותן ר׳ וכ׳</he> when thou seest me put hot water (to the wine), put thou cold water in &c., i.e. when I am angry, appease thou me &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 61b:4">B. Mets. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>ובמשורה שלא יַרְתִּיחַ</he> ‘and in liquid measure’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:35">Lev. XIX, 35</cite>) one is warned that one must not make the liquid foam; <cite ref="Bava Batra 89b">B. Bath. 89ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:5">Tosef. ib. V, 5</cite> <he>אין … לא להַרְתִּיחַ … ולא להקפיצה</he> (Var. <he>להרתיע</he>) the storekeeper is not permitted to make the liquid bubble in the measure, or to make it bound.

<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:20">Tosef. Yoma I, 20</cite> <he>עששיות … היו מַרְתִּיחִין וכ׳</he> they heated &c.; (<cite ref="Yoma 34b:4">Yoma 34ᵇ</cite> <he>מחמין</he>); v. <cite ref="P01515"><he>עֲשָׁשִׁית</he></cite>. Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13ᵇ <he>הסלעים מרתיחין</he> the rocks give out heat; Y. Sabb. IV, 6ᵇ bot.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:17:1">Cant. R. to II, 17</cite> <he>עד שאַרְתִּיחַ היום</he> until I shall make the day hot (for Israel’s enemies); a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 5:8">Tosef. Pes. V, 8</cite> <he>אינו מַרְתִּיחַ</he> does not get hot, v. <cite ref="U02003"><he>שָׂרַף</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:5">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> <he>התחילו … מרתיחים</he> (not <he>מרתיתים</he>) the walls of the house began to be hot; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115:1">Yalk. ib. 115</cite>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> (playon <he>אר̇ת̇ח̇ש̇ש̇ת̇א</he>) <he>שהיה מר̇ת̇יח̇ ות̇ש̇</he> he used to be hot (angry), and weaken (relent) again.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:5">Cant. R. to IV, 5</cite> two families <he>אחת מיקרת ואחת מַרְתַּחַת</he> one of which was cold-blooded, and the other hot-blooded; a. e.

senses.gloss: to heat, boil. [Yalk. Gen. 27 רי׳ עליו, v. רָתָה]—Part. pass. מְרוּתָּח, pl. מְרוּתָּחִין.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>מיעיה של אשה מר׳ וכ׳</he> the inner parts of woman are hot &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:5">Sabb. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 40b:8">Pes. 40ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
